verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature, for example in the Customer Area, is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Adyen. The MCP server only lets developers use natural language through their own external LLM client, which is an adjacent building block. The tip "suggested" amount is a merchant-set value, not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
